reference.source: Psychiatry topic map (Marrow e6 topic selection only; text rewritten in own words, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Attention deficit plus fluctuation defines delirium
Hypoactive delirium is commonest missed and deadliest
Antipsychotics reserved for severe danger, not routine delirium
Benzodiazepines treat withdrawal delirium, worsen others
reference.pathophysiology: Multifactorial failure of attentional networks from systemic inflammation, metabolic derangement and anticholinergic or dopaminergic drug imbalance on a vulnerable (often demented, sensory impaired) brain.
additionalDifferentials: Delirium versus dementia versus depression (pseudodementia attention)
Hyperactive delirium versus mania or psychosis (acuity, attention)
Lewy body fluctuation versus delirium superimposed
additionalInvestigations: Collateral baseline and CAM or 4AT assessment
Sepsis and metabolic screen, medication review
EEG for non convulsive status when unexplained persistence
